notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Added gear display for people getting confused about finding the reverse gear.
Adjusted drone models to make straight flying smoother.

notes.title: Drones Update
notes.content:
4 Drone models utilizing our Softbody Physics Engine and

6 Axis Gyro
Torque Vectoring
Automatic Braking
Automatic Altitude Hold

Special UI for drone telemetry data.

Drone physics were developed based on real drone flying experience.
Use a gamepad for better control of drones.
Input mappings are the same with real drones.

notes.title: New Tracks Update
notes.content:
Added 2 new tracks to the game.
First one has a lot of nice roads and ramps to crash test the vehicles.
The other one is a huge island with nice roads and beaches.

Realityocean Games

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Driving on asphalt is very smooth without any bounce and shake now.
Fix for shadow glitches appearing on vehicles while looking from certain distance or angles.
Fixes for camera direction calculation.
Rear gear ratio fix for Vapor 6x6 truck.
Replaced terrain textures of "The Ring" racetrack.

notes.title: Various improvements and bug fixes
notes.content:
More stable beam force calculation and reduced jittering.
Improved wheel stability for speeds over 300 km/h.
Fixed the issue in terrain transitions in new terrain physics.
Some adjustments and improvements on many vehicles.
Various bug fixes in game menus.

notes.title: Monthly Update
notes.content:
Added openable doors to all vehicles which can be triggered with
buttons appearing on the doors when you move the mouse over.
Added rear doors to cars which does not have rear doors.
Fixed the energy drift issue appears after crashing a bus.
Changed the suspension force calculation completely and tuned vehicles suspensions.

Realityocean Games

notes.title: Physics Improvement Update
notes.content:
Smoother driving on hills and more realistic collision response on steep terrain
with updated realtime collision functions.
Fix of the collision between vehicles with a brand new collision detection system.
Changed the old grass rendering system with a more efficient system,
up to 50% FPS increase in 4K resolution.

Realityocean Games

notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.content:
On the 25th of November we have the 1st anniversary of EQDRIVE.IO
We made 17 updates to the game in one year and improved the game substantially.
Currently update count is more than the twice of the reviews for our game.
Today's update is enabling the Full Controller Support to the game, with no dead ends.
No need for keyboard and mouse after starting the game from the Steam Client.
Even most of the game settings can be changed with a gamepad controller.

[b]There is a 40% discount special to the anniversary in Steam Autumn Sale.[/b]

--- Complete list of updates ---
Added Full Controller Support to the Game
Redesigned Controller Mapping Menu
Redesigned Vehicle Manager Menu
Added Recover Vehicle feature to Vehicle Manager
Added Go to Spawn Point feature to Vehicle Manager
Added Invert Mouse Input option to Gameplay Settings
Fixed thread timing issues while multiple vehicles are in use
Fixed wrong calculation of force feedback while multiple vehicles are in use
Fixed engine sound level in vehicle interiors
Fixed swing stopping issue in some theme park rides

Realityocean Games

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Added 12 languages for the game's user interface
Added interior cameras to boats
Increased some rides speed and torque in Themepark
Fixed some visual issues in Themepark
Enabled crash sounds for vehicles

notes.title: Theme Park Update
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the Theme Park Update is finally available.
This update includes 6 thrill rides those are specially modelled and engineered for EQDRIVE.IO
You can see all rides in the Theme Park scene and ride each one of them.
In this update we also added electric motors for thrill rides to our physics engine.
All theme park rides just like other vehicles in the game uses our own softbody physics engine.
You can watch the rides from the outside or change to the onboard cameras.
Controlling rides are very simple and fun. Swinging rides have automatic swinging function.

Realityocean Games

notes.title: Various improvements and bug fixes
notes.content:
Gamepad driving improvement.
Vehicle handling improvement.
Pivot camera improvement.
Added physics safeguard system that prevents game crashes.
Water collision physics optimization.
Physics bug fixes in Middle East map.
Split shift transmission bug fix.

Realityocean Games

notes.title: Boats Update
notes.content:
Now it's possible to sail in EQDRIVE.IO.
Three types of sea vehicles are available. Tug, yacht and boat.

We also published the demo of EQDRIVE.IO
Demo includes the Desert Dunes map and one offroad truck.

Realityocean Games

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Fixed the issue in Airplane collisions.

notes.title: Airplane Update
notes.content:
Now you can fly an airplane in EQDRIVE.IO
On Katadhin Island and Madeira Island maps
you can find an Airport spawn point suitable for taking off and landing an airplane.
We are continuing to working on the game to add ships 
and thrill rides from theme parks as we promised last month.
They might be available next week.
We might also add more airplanes but currently only one airplane is available in the game.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
We added a system to teleport you to the nearest road
when you have to respawn after falling into the sea.
Also made a few changes in collision detection of the trees to avoid game freezing.

Realityocean Games

notes.title: Monthly Update
notes.content:
Fixed vehicles stuck into steep terrain while vehicles are sliding down the terrain.
Fixed excessive bouncing of vehicles after spawning.
Adjusted in game vehicle spawner to consider terrain height,
while choosing a position to spawn the new vehicle.
Added option to go to main menu from in game ESC menu.
Reduced default graphics quality settings. (Can be changed from game settings)
Added auto hide mouse cursor in game.

Realityocean Games

notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
As we approach important weeks of gaming,
We wanted to publish a new update for our game.

Fixed shadow flickering on steep terrain.
Reduced clutch vibration at low speeds.
Tuned CVT transmission to accelerate faster to higher speeds.
Tuned automated manual and torque converter transmission for more dynamic driving.
Fixed vehicle explosion while bouncing off barriers.
Fixed vehicle explosion while respawning outside terrain on Gridmap.

Added exhaust brake to buses and trucks with split shift transmission.
It also adjusts gears to increase exhaust brake force.
Press B to enable the exhaust brake.

We recommend pressing to "Restore Defaults" button in controller settings of the game,
if you played the game before the update.

Spawning a new vehicle next to current vehicle is now possible.
This was a prerequisite for adding trailers or other loads for semi trucks.
Please leave a review if you enjoy the game and have ideas to improve the gameplay.

Realityocean Games

notes.title: Force Feedback and Manual Transmission Update
notes.content:
Added DirectInput Force Feedback which does support all
Logitech, Thrustmaster and Fanatec steering wheels.
Added various transmission options to all vehicles including manual transmission
which can work with or without H-Shifter.
Improved wheel physics calculation and stability.
Fixed buses spinning uncontrollably after a collision.
Fixed problems with locking differentials and added automatic differential lock option.
Adjusted most of the trucks and buses physics designs for smoother driving.

Realityocean Games

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
We redesigned Gridmap with a lot of interesting obstacles and platforms to test drive vehicles.
Added a new game scene featuring a sci-fi city and elevated racetracks(with checkpoints and timer).
Added one more bus and sports car added to the game. (24 vehicles in total)
Added more colors to vehicles and improved shading.
Fixed the car rendering issue affecting players from US and UK.
Added high quality textures to all vehicle interiors.
Re-programmed the tire friction model to allow drifts and sliding.
Improved physics performance over 20%
Fixed problems about respawning vehicles.
Improved multi vehicle support and collision between vehicles(Beta).
Added ability to rotate interior camera.

Realityocean Games

notes.title: Performance Update
notes.content:
We were planning to add 5 more vehicles to the game this week but found that
we had to do a lot of work for optimizing the runtime code.
Now there is no chance to run out of memory or cpu when you switch scenes multiple times in the game.
Additionally I fixed a few missing things on 10 vehicles added last week
and made some more improvements on engine and transmissions.
We hope more players for our game in the new year and wishing happy new year to everyone.

Realityocean Games

notes.title: Christmas Update is available
notes.content:
Christmas Update including 10 brand new vehicles is available.
There are different types of vehicles in the update.
Such as 3 passenger Vans,
2 Pickup Truck,
A 6x6 Offroad Truck,
A City Bus,
A Mini Bus,
A Panelvan,
A Station Wagon car,

We also fixed a few game braking bugs, improved engine and transmissions, optimized gamepad driving.

There will be an additional 5 vehicles in Christmas Update part 2 next week.

We are continuously working to improve the game. Share your thoughts about the game with us.

Realityocean Games

notes.title: New Vehicles Update
notes.content:
We are going to add 10 more vehicles to the game on December 22 including the passenger van seen in the photo. Most of the vehicles in the update are commercial vehicles. There are also a shorter wheelbase van and a flatbed similar to the passenger van in the update. We are also working on some improvements in the collision model. 5 more additional vehicles are also in our development pipeline. They will be available before December 30 with an other update.
